_source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (ODbL), routed with our own Dijkstra in app/data/fetch_roads.py
_format: road_id -> citizen_id -> destination -> [extra_seconds, extra_meters] when that road alone is closed (free-flow; the engine scales seconds by TRAFFIC_FACTOR like OSRM times). Missing = no detour. unreachable_pairs: homes with no other way out keep local access (no detour).
